name: Jeff Dean
title: Chief Scientist, Google
bio: Jeff Dean is the Chief Scientist of Google, leading advanced AI research and computing infrastructure. He co-designed fundamental Google systems including MapReduce, BigTable, Spanner, TensorFlow, and early TPU architectures. Member of the National Academy of Engineering.

name: Demis Hassabis
title: CEO, Google DeepMind
bio: Sir Demis Hassabis is the co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind and Nobel Laureate in Chemistry (2024). He led pioneering projects including AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and AlphaFold, demonstrating that AI can solve grand biological challenges.

name: Hartmut Neven
title: VP of Engineering & Founder, Quantum AI
bio: Hartmut Neven leads the Google Quantum AI laboratory in Santa Barbara, pioneering superconducting quantum processors from Sycamore to Willow, achieving quantum supremacy and demonstrating distance-7 surface code error suppression below threshold.

name: Pushmeet Kohli
title: VP of Research, Science & Robust AI
bio: Pushmeet Kohli leads AI for Science initiatives at Google DeepMind, directing research at the interface of deep learning, quantum chemistry, structural biology (AlphaFold), and mathematical theorem proving (AlphaGeometry).

name: Corinna Cortes
title: VP of Research, Google New York
bio: Corinna Cortes is a computer scientist renowned for co-inventing Support Vector Machines (SVM). She heads Google's research center in New York, conducting fundamental work in theoretical machine learning, online learning algorithms, and ranking.

name: Marian Croak
title: VP of Engineering, Responsible AI
bio: Marian Croak is a Vice President of Engineering at Google leading the Responsible AI and Human-Centered Technology organization. She is an inductee into the National Inventors Hall of Fame and holds over 200 patents in telecommunications and computing.

name: John Jumper
title: Senior Staff Research Scientist & Director, AlphaFold
bio: John Jumper is a Director at Google DeepMind and co-recipient of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for computational protein structure prediction. He led the architecture design and training of AlphaFold 2 and AlphaFold 3.

name: Yossi Matias
title: VP of Engineering & Research
bio: Yossi Matias is a Vice President of Engineering and Research at Google leading initiatives in FloodHub, conversational AI, and crisis response systems. Recipient of the Gödel Prize and ACM Fellow.
